---
title: "Project C · 3 – phosphosite follow-up"
subtitle: "Bio253 HS2026 · group mval · Steps 8–9, recomputed live"
---

Short, re-runnable version of Steps 8–9. Full scripts: `scripts/08_phospho_coverage_mval.R`,
`09_site_vs_protein_mval.R`. STY and STYH are two searches of the same runs, not
replicates; STY is primary (near tie with STYH, same results, Step 8).

```{r setup}
source("../R/setup.R")
sites <- read_sites("STY") |> keep_je2()
prim  <- read_samples() |> filter(medium %in% c("TSB", "SN")) |> pull(sample)
```

## Coverage and localisation

Rule (fixed before selection): localised = **median of the per-sample** `loc_prob` over the
primary samples where the site was seen ≥ 0.75. `best_loc_prob` is only the best of 27.

```{r localisation}
loc <- sites |> filter(sample %in% prim, !is.na(intensity)) |>
  group_by(site_id, residue) |>
  summarise(median_loc = median(loc_prob), best = first(best_loc_prob), .groups = "drop")
loc |> group_by(residue) |>
  summarise(detected = n(), localised_median_rule = sum(median_loc >= 0.75), localised_best_only = sum(best >= 0.75))
```

Usable sites per contrast (≥ 2 of 3 per group + localised + S/T/Y):

```{r coverage}
read_csv("../mval_medi/results/step08_phospho_coverage/coverage_per_contrast_mval.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(search == "STY") |> select(contrast, je2_sites, eligible_2of3, supported_STY)
```

## The Stk1 phosphosite follows the protein

```{r stk1-site, fig.height=4}
plot_sites(unique(sites$site_id[sites$locus_tag == "B7H15_06355" & sites$position %in% c(164, 166)]), sites)
```

## Site vs protein, same contrast (Step 9)

Adjusted effect = site − protein (log2, same contrast, observed estimates only). Its SE assumes
independent layers (descriptive, no p-value).

```{r categories}
read_csv("../mval_medi/results/step09_site_vs_protein/category_counts_mval.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(search == "STY")
```

**Result:** the phospho layer adds no evidence about altered PASN responses (no site hit in
the mutant-vs-`anc` interactions); it supports H1 (Stk1 site lost with the protein).

```{r session}
sessionInfo()
```
